notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware run was made and none is claimed. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the upstream interface, so there is no deviation from the card. The driver serves webots_drone/DroneEnvContinuous-v0 with env_kwargs is_pixels=False: cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action.values} bounded by the simulator control ranges, cap.world.reset.v1 takes {seed, options} and cap.world.seed.v1 takes {seed}; only cap.world.* catalogue classes are used, so there are no extension ids and no catalogue requests. NOT COVERED: the default 3x84x84 RGB uint8 camera observation (is_pixels=True); the package serves the 22-element vector observation. The gate and the fake need neither the upstream package nor Webots: fake.py is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in and was not compared with a Webots run. The sim backend (gym.make with the upstream package, Webots R2023b and WEBOTS_HOME) was not run. The fake's initial pose, attitude-to-speed and thrust-to-speed gains, distance-sensor readings and target position are model data marked '# placeholder' in fake.py, not Facts or Limits. timestep_ms 1000 is the nominal environment macro-step (the clone draws 120-130 Webots base steps of 8 ms, so 960-1040 ms); the fake integrates once per environment step, while the physics base step is 8 ms. Two expected warning classes remain: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for integer/numeric bridge inputs (seed in reset, seed in seed, action.values and ticks); declaring actions for reset and seed to add units would expose the reset inputs scenario and options without descriptions. The upstream clone stayed unmodified, no network was used and no hardware backend was opened. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
